notes.subject: מתחולל
notes.rationale: Root חול 'twist/writhe': 'writhe in pain' (KJV/ASV) vs 'labor like a woman in childbirth' (Geneva) vs 'tormented' — Tok Pisin 'i pen gut olgeta taim' keeps the bodily twisting sense.

notes.subject: ומספר שנים
notes.rationale: 'The number of years' (KJV) vs 'a small number of years, few' (YLT, following מִסְפַּר as indefinite-few); rendered neutrally as 'namba bilong ol yia'.

notes.subject: לעריץ
notes.rationale: 'for the tyrant/oppressor' (the wicked man himself) vs 'from the tyrant' (reading לְ as 'away from') — rendered 'long man i gat strongpela strong' following the majority.

translation: Olgeta dei bilong man nogut, em i pen gut olgeta taim; na olgeta kain namba bilong ol yia i stap Hait long man i gat strongpela strong long lukautim ol man.
